title: Sustainable water remediation with algae-derived adsorbents: from synthesis strategies to adsorption performance and mechanisms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18770-18800
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09740A, Review Article
Open Access

Tongtong Wang, Soni Patyal, Mu. Naushad, Pooja Dhiman, Gaurav Sharma, Ying Gao, Sen Wang, Weiqian Li, Jinjun Cai
This review covers the synthesis, modification, and mechanisms of algae-derived carbon-rich adsorbents for sustainable removal of human-driven industrial pollutants from water, noting their high efficiency, reusability, and application potential.
